issues.legal_issue: New restrictions on a landlord’s right to terminate a protected agricultural tenancy apply when the tenancy terminates after those restrictions take effect, even if the termination notice was served earlier.
material_facts: The landlord served a one-year notice of termination before the amendment introducing further restrictions took effect.
The tenancy had not terminated when the amendment took effect and terminated only after the notice period expired.
The landlord later sought possession, and the tenant claimed the protection of the new restrictions.
issues.conclusion: The new restrictions applied because the tenancy terminated after the amendment took effect. The landlord could obtain possession only if the termination complied with those restrictions; applying them did not divest the landlord of a vested right.
issues.legal_principle: Under ss. 34(1) and 34(2-A) of the Bombay Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1948, as amended, the restrictions govern when the tenancy actually terminates, not when notice is served. A notice declares an intention to terminate, and the landlord acquires a vested right to obtain possession only after the notice period expires and the tenancy terminates. The Court followed Durlabbhai Fakirbhai v. Jhaverbhai Bhikabhai (1956) 58 Bom. L.R. 85 and distinguished Jeebankrishna Chakrabarti v. Abdul Kader Choudhuri (1933) I.L.R. LX Cal. 1037. Any doubt about the amendment’s meaning should be resolved in favour of tenants because it is beneficial legislation.

rule.if: protected_agricultural_tenancy_possession_proceeding and landlord_served_termination_notice and notice_preceded_new_restrictions and tenancy_unterminated_when_new_restrictions_took_effect and landlord_claims_possession_after_termination

predicates.protected_agricultural_tenancy_possessio: The proceeding concerns a landlord’s claim to possession following termination of a protected agricultural tenancy.
predicates.landlord_served_termination_notice: The landlord served the tenant with a notice stating an intention to terminate the tenancy.
predicates.notice_preceded_new_restrictions: The landlord served the termination notice before further restrictions on termination took effect.
predicates.tenancy_unterminated_when_new_restrictio: The tenancy had not terminated when the further restrictions took effect.
predicates.landlord_claims_possession_after_termina: After the tenancy terminated, the landlord sought possession of the land.

issues.definition: When a landlord seeks possession in a protected agricultural tenancy proceeding after giving notice before new restrictions took effect, and the tenancy was still ongoing when they took effect, the termination is subject to those restrictions.
